name: 6th Guwahati Open 2024

venue.name: Birinchi Kumar Barua Khetra
venue.address: Shiv Mandir Path, Krishna Nagar, Chandmari, Guwahati, Assam 781004

information: * Make sure to be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate. * Attend the new participates tutorial session if you're new to WCA competitions or unfamiliar with its rules. * Bring a Government ID card for verification if it's your first time participating in a WCA competition. * Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned with roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers.
